summary: Frontend-only validation of PMC vendor registration /register flow for Malaysia. All five requested scenarios PASS: (1) new-draft start navigates to /register/resume?token=…; (2) Section A shows 'Registration Number (SSM Registration No.)' with hint 'Expected format: 201901000005', surfaces a format error for 'abc', and clears the error for '201901000005' (Tax ID hint 'C2584563202' also shown correctly); (3) Section C bank typeahead uses a native <datalist> populated via /api/v1/masters/banks?country_code=MY with Maybank, CIMB Bank, Public Bank, HSBC, Hong Leong, OCBC, RHB, Standard Chartered, AmBank, Bank Islam — selecting 'Maybank' auto-fills SWIFT with 'MBBEMYXXX', 'CIMB Bank' → 'CIBBMYXXX'; (4) Section D operating-regions editor: country MY picked via combobox, State input accepts the free-typed 'Testville Province' (not blocked, not disabled), City becomes enabled as soon as State has a value, ZIP shows live error for 'ABCDE' and clears for '50000' (format hint '#####' displayed in label), and '+ Add office' adds op-region-row-0 successfully; (5) no fatal console errors or blank screens — only harmless 401/404 from unauthenticated public helper endpoints common to this app.
critical_code_review_comments: RegionOfficeEditor.jsx uses native <input list=…><datalist> for State/City — intentional per spec; works but note native datalists don't filter visually on all browsers until user interacts; UX acceptable.
SectionC bank picker also relies on native <datalist> — reliable and keyboard-friendly; SWIFT prefix is auto-filled with trailing 'XXX' padding, which matches the swift_prefix+XXX convention.
seed_data_creation: None — used a fresh unique email per run (test_my_<ts>@example.com); no final submission performed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All five scenarios in the review request pass end-to-end on the preview URL. Section D state is a type-or-pick <input list='op-region-state-dl'> (testid op-region-new-state); City enables when draft.state has any value (not tied to state_code), ZIP live-validated via country postal_code_regex from /api/v1/masters/countries. Note: step B/C/D/E tabs are gated by Section A required fields (company_name, registered_address, legal_entity_type, incorporation_date) — fill those first to navigate.
